CITY OF HAWAIIAN GARDENS  Thursday, August 29, 2024
FINANCE COMMITTEE MINUTES  Special Meeting, 11:00 AM

  Ernesto Marquez,City Manager
Maria Teresa Del Rio, Councilmember  Linda Hollinsworth, Finance Director
  Victor Farfan, Mayor

  MINUTES
CALL TO ORDER

The Finance Committee meeting was called to order on Thursday, August 29, 2024, at 11:07 AM.

ROLL CALL
PRESENT

  Victor Farfan, Mayor
  Maria Teresa Del Rio, Councilmember
  Ernesto Marquez, City Manager
  Linda Hollinsworth, Finance Director
PUBLIC COMMENTS - GENERAL OR ITEMS ON OR OFF THE AGENDA

There were no Public Comments.

 A. DISCUSSION ITEM(S)
 1.  End of Fiscal Year Snapshot of Expenses and Revenues.

  Linda Hollinsworth, Finance Director, presented a snapshot of the end of Fiscal Year
  Expenses and Revenues.
 2.  Diversifying City Revenues/Cost saving Measures.

  Ernesto Marquez, City Manager, presented information for diversifying the city revenues.

  The Committee discussed about bringing commercial tenants to the shopping centers;
  cannabis trends; Transient Occupancy Tax; development opportunities at the medical
  building/hospital site; revisiting the citywide fee schedule; and potential budget cuts.

 B. NEW BUSINESS

There were no New Business Items.

 C. ADJOURNMENT

The Finance Committee meeting was adjourned at 11:59 AM.
